blocks.text: You asked whether we can give you a read on any of the surviving marks before the formal report. Not yet, and I will not guess at it. The full clearance search is running on all the survivors at once, and until it closes I have hits to log, not a view to hand you.

What I can promise is that a head-on collision does not wait for the report. If the search turns up a mark that plainly blocks one of the candidates Jackson Inc gave us, you will hear it from me the day it surfaces. The considered read on the rest, mark by mark, comes in the written report, after counsel has reviewed it.

Our contact record still shows Cynthia Hunter as the single approver for the {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} clearance, so anything that needs a decision comes to you first. Kelly Snyder is logging every hit against the docket as the search returns them, so nothing slips between the search and the report.

One thing would help. If your board has a date in view for this decision, send it to me, and I will tell you plainly whether the report can be ready before it or whether we should plan a short interim note in the meantime.
